extracted.name: Slow cooker mulled cider
extracted.description: Planning a Christmas party? Let guests help themselves to this festive mulled cider – simply plug the slow cooker in and ladle into heatproof glasses
ingredient_lines: 3 cardamom pods bruised using a rolling pin
instruction_lines: Put all the ingredients except the calvados in a slow cooker and cook for 1 hr on high or up to 4 hrs on low.
Just before serving, stir in the calvados. Ladle into heatproof glasses or cups to serve.
